total_load.total_load_placement: source whole-facility label; physical deployment not independently verified
total_load.method: Sort timestamps; parse explicit W/kW; trapezoidal power integration on intervals <=60 seconds; no gap filling or prorating; assign intervals to endpoint source-clock date.

energy_assumptions.formula: 80*0.8 and 20*0.8; fixed assumed output multiplied by logged/inferred runtime
energy_assumptions.status: Not measured generator electrical output. Generator-II calculation warnings, date alignment and missing-to-zero formulas remain unresolved.

cost_assumptions.generator_purchase_units: Source comment: units are probably dollars
cost_assumptions.status: Conditional bookkeeping proxy, not verified USD expenditure. Grid purchases differ from energy used; fuel inventory, unit price, maintenance and battery/solar supply are not reconciled.

existing_notebook_issue.issue: Sums 60 kW readings without dividing by 60 and labels as kWh. Also groups unsorted source rows into positional blocks. Those energy results are not used.

period_limits: 2023 total-load baseline and 2020-2022 ledger shares are different periods. Do not apply historical energy shares to 2023 measured kWh/day or describe them as current post-PSA demand. January 2025 logged generator hours are not whole-facility kWh.
